ipc.סיווג: chart-sections, chart-tree, chart-subclasses, chart-scatter, chart-depth, chart-depth-sec, chart-groups, kpi:codes, kpi:main, kpi:subclasses, insight:lead, insight:class, insight:concentration, insight:biggest, insight:residual — the code string carries section/class/subclass/main group; '/00' marks a main group
ipc.סיווג אב: chart-depth, chart-depth-sec, chart-fan, insight:depth, insight:leaves — parent links give the tree: level below the main group, leaves and fan-out
ipc.תיאור הסיווג: chart-depth, insight:fragments, insight:residual — English heading text; only its continuation-fragment form (lower-case start) and residual 'not provided for' headings are measured, the text itself stays in the explorer
ipc.קבוצת סיווג: skip: duplicates the first four characters of the code (subclass), which compute derives from the code itself
ipc.תאריך גרסה: kpi:version, insight:version — edition date of the scheme (one value per edition today)
